Title: 
Software Engineer 
 
 Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! 
 
 
 KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.
 
 
 Why Join Us? 
 Innovative Projects: Develop and modernize secure software applications using Java, Python, Angular, AWS, and advanced data technologies
 Collaborative Environment: Work with software engineers, system administrators, data professionals, and mission partners to solve complex technical challenges
 Impactful Work: Deliver reliable, scalable, and secure applications that directly support critical customer missions
 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack software applications using Java, Python, JavaScript, Angular, HTML, SQL, and Hibernate
 Develop and integrate application services, database components, user interfaces, and data processing capabilities across Windows and Linux environments
 Build, maintain, and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using Git, Gradle, Maven, Jenkins, and related development tools
 Develop and deploy cloud-based solutions using AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Auto Scaling, and related technologies
 Perform unit, integration, regression, and system testing to ensure software quality, reliability, security, and performance
 Troubleshoot complex application, database, integration, and infrastructure issues through effective debugging and performance optimization
 Collaborate with technical and mission teams to understand requirements, recommend solutions, document software designs, and deliver production-ready capabilities
 
 
 Work Environment: 
 Location: On-site
 Travel Requirements: Minimal
 Working Hours: Standard
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Security Clearance: Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph
 Operating Environments: Windows, Linux, AWS, Tomcat, Oracle, and FidOS
 Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline
 Experience: Minimum of 12 years of relevant software engineering or information technology experience
 Education Equivalency: Bachelor’s degree with two additional years of specialized experience, or six additional years of specialized experience in place of a college degree
 Demonstrated experience developing software using Java, Python, JavaScript, Angular, HTML, SQL, and Hibernate
 Experience with continuous integration and delivery tools, including Git and Jenkins, and build tools such as Gradle or Maven
 Experience with unit and integration testing, software debugging, performance optimization, relational and non-relational databases, and data engineering or analytics tools
 
 
 Desired: 
 Experience deploying and maintaining applications using Tomcat, Oracle, Windows, Linux, and AWS
 Experience with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, and Auto Scaling
 Experience with Elasticsearch and large-scale search, data indexing, or analytics solutions
 Experience with supporting technologies such as Puppet, Nexus, SQL Developer, and Eclipse
 Experience designing secure, scalable, and highly available applications in classified or mission-critical environments
 Knowledge of infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams
 
 
 
 Basic Compensation: 
 $205,500 to $251,200 annual salary
 
 This range is for the Virginia area only 
 
 The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.
 
 Additional Compensation: 
 KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.
 
 Ready to Make a Difference? 
 If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.
 
 KBR Benefits 
 KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.
 
 
 
 Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture.  These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company.  That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. 
 
 KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
